notes.title: Tilted Mind Free Demo Now Available!
notes.notes:
A Demo version of Tilted Mind is now available so you can try it out before you buy.  The Demo version lets you play the first 2 mazes.

If anyone has played this game, please consider making a review of it since right now there aren't any Steam reviews.

notes.title: Optional Body Tracking
notes.notes:
[img=http://cloud-3.steamusercontent.com/ugc/832448138113504013/1CE99F2180C5C812BE1BBFD6D883AA1E579AD799/][img]


The game can be played with optional body tracking if you have 3 Vive Trackers in addition to your 2 controllers. Attach one Vive Tracker to the top of each foot and one to your back on your belt. (Calibrate the body after the intro video has played by pressing down in the menu and choosing "Recalibrate Body.") If you want to try body tracking and have only 2 Vive Trackers, you can still try it, but it's not optimized for 2 Trackers. 

[img=http://cloud-3.steamusercontent.com/ugc/832448138113475391/38B20EA1B9A5819A6FC481AE484DADCFC7D8ACD2/][img]
